column1: # mapping_set_title: ISO/IEC 22989:2022 to ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Schema Mappings

# mapping_set_description: Schema-level mappings between the ISO/IEC 22989:2022 (Artificial intelligence concepts and terminology) and ISO/IEC 27001:2022 (Information security management system) LinkML schemas. Mappings cover the harmonised Annex SL terms (Organization, InterestedParty) shared across all ISO management-system standards and the risk-related concepts (RiskItem ↔ Risk) carried into both AI and information-security risk programmes.

column10: Annex SL harmonised definition shared by ISO/IEC 22989 and ISO/IEC 27001.
Annex SL harmonised definition of an interested party (stakeholder) shared by both standards.
Both model risk using source, event, consequence and likelihood. ISO/IEC 22989 risk is AI-specific; ISO/IEC 27001 risk is information-security specific.
An AI system is an asset to be protected under an ISMS; the relation is asset-management rather than equivalence.
A dataset used by an AI system is an information asset under ISO/IEC 27001.
Privacy as a trustworthiness property is supported by ISO/IEC 27001 Annex A controls (notably A.5.34 Privacy and protection of PII).
Security as an AI trustworthiness property is operationalised through an ISMS conformant to ISO/IEC 27001.
